Stock market news | FII flows, US inflation and crude oil drive Nifty outlook

On 22 November 2026, analysts highlighted that foreign institutional investor (FII) buying, US inflation figures and crude oil prices are the top factors to watch for the Indian market next week.
These variables will shape whether the Nifty can break the 26,000 level, influencing investor sentiment across sectors.
